resources.string: Analog pedals (touch and drag up to press harder), throttle lock (turn it on in settings) and three pages of quick actions: truck (engine, trailer, wipers…), driving (retarder, engine brake, cruise speed, quick park) and view (cameras, map, dashboard, radio). Update Truck Remote Server on your PC to use them. Steering sensitivity is now set in the app with a live preview, the server can be found by its QR code. The steering uses the gyroscope together with the accelerometer and an adaptive filter: smooth, without a lag. Long press a quick action to put any other action in its place; the steering smoothness is set in the settings. On the dashboard: warnings (air, oil, overheating, fuel, wear, rest) and the distance and time to the destination; the panel shows the diff lock, the lift axle and the retarder level (update Truck Remote Server). Auto pause: the controls are released while the phone lies screen down. The cargo, destination and time left are shown during a job; the screen is dimmed while the controls are paused. Low fuel shows the range; speed units can be chosen in the settings; ETS2 and ATS can have separate steering, quick actions and units (the game is detected by itself).

This app is designed to be used as a steering wheel in some popular truck simulators like Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.

Developer: Alex Churkin

Contact:
churkinapps@gmail.com

Icons, libraries and their licenses are listed in Settings → Third-party software and licenses.
First, download Truck Remote Server and run it on the computer with the game. You can do it by this link: https://github.com/alexChurkin/TruckRemoteServer .

The server shows its address and QR code (scan it in the app settings if the phone doesn\'t find the server). Then start the game and select Keyboard + vJoy in Controls. The steering sensitivity is set in the app settings.
It\'s important to use only \"Simple Automatic\" transmission and set \"Steering sensitivity\" and \"Steering non-linearity\" as follows:
When using force feedback, it is also recommended to disable all types of feedback in the game, except for the Collisions (50%), Bumps (~15%) and Terrain (~10%).
Make sure all keys in the control settings are set as standard. Enter the game and proceed to the next step.

Make sure that your phone or tablet is connected to the same network as the computer. Connect Truck Remote Control to the server on your computer: it can be found automatically, or you can set its IP address in the settings.
Turn cruise control on by swiping up on the gas pedal, turn it off by swiping again or touching the brake.
Touch a pedal and drag up to press it harder, down to release. Bind vJoy Y and Z axes to gas and brake in the game
A pedal is fully pressed while you touch it (arrow keys in the game)
While holding the gas, swipe sideways to keep its level. Touch the gas or the brake to release it
Analog pedals need Y and Z axes enabled in vJoy on the PC. Keys are used for now

The search goes on in the background. Please check that:

• Truck Remote Server is running on the PC
• the phone and the PC are connected to the same network (guest Wi-Fi networks often don't let devices see each other)
• the server is allowed in Windows Firewall (the server offers it on the first start)
• the port is the same in the app and in the server

You can also enter the server IP address (shown in the server window) in Settings.
